start.card:
Here is a number: 0.999…
The three dots mean the 9s go on forever. Is it exactly 1, or a tiny bit less than 1?
Pick your guess below.
start.title: Is 0.999… equal to 1?

afterGuess.card:
You picked “A tiny bit less than 1”. Let's test it.
The bar is 1 metre of ribbon, shared fairly by 3 friends. Each should get 1/3 of a metre. (1/3 is a fraction: 1 split into 3 equal parts.)
Press “Cut and share” to cut the ribbon into 10 equal pieces and hand them out.
afterGuess.title: Is 0.999… equal to 1?

after.card:
Cut 3: the leftover became 10 pieces of 1 mm. Each friend got 3, so each now has 0.333 m. Together they have 0.999 m.
1 grey piece is left over. Press “Cut and share” to cut it into 10 smaller pieces. One more cut, then look for the pattern.
after.title: Is 0.999… equal to 1?
